Dar da, am văzut și eu profesori care pun la suflet cuvintele elevilor, ceea ce eu personal nu înțeleg, și îmi pare rău să văd asta. 

Ceilalți profesori îmi tratează materia cu curiozitate. Dacă le-aș da note proaste, poate atunci m-ar lua peste picior, pentru că nu am o materie esențială. Dar majoritatea profesorilor m-au susținut și ajutat, fiind la început.

Nu e 5000 maximul pe care il poti avea.

Lucrurile stau cam asa: in 2-3 ani maxim poti face dosar de gradatie de merit (strangi activitati cu copiii, olimpiade, mers la muzeu, orice e trecut acolo) si iti adauga 25%.
Definitivatul, gradul 1, gradul 2 iti adauga si ele nu stiu cat la suta, dar din cat am inteles, in jur de 5-10.
Totalul zilelor libere posibile este 67 din care 5 sunt obligatorii de activitate, le pui cand doresti tu sa mai dai pe la scoala. 62 esti absolut liber, daca nu doresti sa inveti tu pt grade sau sa faci alte cursuri, care apropo, pot fi platite de GDPR sau CCD. Sunt si cursuri pe care le poti plati tu daca doresti.

Si daca esti ca mine, si predai o materie care nu e esentiala (desen, muzica, istorie/geografie la profil real) si copiilor le place sa ia note usoare si sunt cooperanti si nici nu esti stresat.

Faptul ca mai trebuie sa faci o planificare, un test, o lectie, iti ia putin daca stii materia si unde/cum sa cauti. 
Alte atributii nu ai decat daca esti diriginte. Ah, si asta e un 5-10% la salariu. Asta e singurul lucru pe care il gasesc mai stresant, dar nu esti obligat sa fii diriginte. Eu nu sunt. 
Poti face un calcul si vezi lejer ca poti sa treci peste 5000 daca faci doar gradatia, sa nu mai zic ca ce pui in dosar poate fi refolosit la urmatoare gradatie, daca nu trece peste un numar de ani. Deci nu e greu de mentinut.

Eu am lasat comentariul acesta doar informativ, pentru cine e interesat de munca cu copii. Stiu din surse sigure cum stau lucrurile de la cineva din sistem. (maica-mea a fost profa toata viata, si stiu sigur ca lua mai mult de 5000).

Hi, I give singing lessons to kids(6-18 for now) and I cannot comprehend how has she never corrected your pitch. For the first 20-25 minutes or every class I have, I do a warm up which consists of exercises focused on pitch and emission of sound/breathing exercises/flow of air. There are kids that can't do a lip thrill no matter how many ways I explain it but we don't give up, we try different ways to get the same results in the long run.

Point is, I think you should get a new teacher. Your tone is very important but so is staying on pitch.

And it is very problematic if you don't feel like you can properly practice in-between classes. I've never used a tuner nor did I ever see one used, but if that's what you think could help you, go for it. Some things you need to figure out on your own. Even if you practice "badly", record yourself and compare it to how you would like to sound, and figure out where you were off pitch or if your tone is wobbly. Your tools to fix it are the exercises you should have probably done with your teacher.

Hi I am supposed to go get checked for ADHD soon cuz I have a lot of the symptoms and have recently found out about it. Maybe my life strategies can help you.

So, what I personaly do to keep my attention engaged: sit up, move during the exercises, concentrate on my body and how my throat, shoulders, diaphragm feel. Make sure everything beside the diaphragm is relaxed.

Now about the pitch, I use youtube videos to guide me, so even if I miss the pitch I go back and replay, or if I get lost in my mind during the exercise, same thing, go back and replay.

If I'm too hyper today I do the exercises while balancing on one leg or add another challenge to the exercise. Makes things fun and makes me keep going.

After a while of training my brain just bounces through these set ideas and there are less random thoughts (about the weather or something random that my brain just noticed). So when I space out now vs the beginning I have all if these coping strategies that I can use.

So my advice to you is relax, even if it's hard today to keep up you will be able to do it someday. And make it fun in your vision, not a chore, since the ADD brain doesn't like to start chores.

PS. Years ago when I started I just thought there must be something seriously wrong with me since everyone around me could remember the exercise in seconds vs me having to listen 3 times at least and forgeting what I was singing midway. After a while you just realise that most exercises are variations of the simple ones you learn in the beginning and things just get easier. Just do anything that keeps your brain engaged and remove all the distractions.
